summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style biography of Charlotte Ritchie, a British actress and singer-songwriter born 29 August 1989. It notes her membership in the classical crossover band All Angels and her main cast roles in Channel 4's Fresh Meat and the BBC's Siblings. It also states she joined the BBC's Call the Midwife in January 2015, playing Barbara Gilbert.
one_line: British actress and singer-songwriter known for Fresh Meat, Siblings, Call the Midwife, and membership in All Angels.
key_facts: Charlotte Ritchie was born on 29 August 1989.
Charlotte Ritchie is a British actress and singer-songwriter.
Charlotte Ritchie is a member of the classical crossover band All Angels.
Charlotte Ritchie has been a main cast member in Channel 4's Fresh Meat.
Charlotte Ritchie has been a main cast member in the BBC's Siblings.
From January 2015, Charlotte Ritchie joined the cast of the BBC's Call the Midwife.
In Call the Midwife, Charlotte Ritchie plays Barbara Gilbert.
